CheckIn.description: A frozen prediction's statistic at a longer horizon: descriptive, never graded.
CheckIn.title: CheckIn

Community.description:
Questions and discussion counts from GitHub Discussions, read when the site was built.

Never part of the record: questions, comments and reactions cannot change a grade.
Community.title: Community

CommunityQuestion.description: A question someone asked in the repository's Q&A discussions. Display only.
CommunityQuestion.title: CommunityQuestion

CommunityThread.description: The discussion thread on a claim or event page, by its term ("claim:<id>").
CommunityThread.title: CommunityThread

GoldLabel.description: A label a person already gave (labels/gold.jsonl is public in the repo anyway).
GoldLabel.title: GoldLabel

HorizonOut.description: The claim's statistic over a longer window, from past events. Descriptive, never graded.
HorizonOut.title: HorizonOut

Instrument.description: A thing with a price, always labeled with where it trades.
Instrument.title: Instrument

LabelCandidate.description:
A recent headline for a person to label. The labeler's own answer is deliberately left out,
so the person labels blind instead of agreeing with it.
LabelCandidate.title: LabelCandidate

LabelerAccuracy.description: The free labeler scored against the people's labels in labels/gold.jsonl.
LabelerAccuracy.title: LabelerAccuracy

LiveHeadline.description:
A current headline from the GDELT Project, labeled by the free rules labeler.

Shown on the News tab only; never written to the event ledger (see spillover.ingest.gdelt).
LiveHeadline.title: LiveHeadline

NewsSource.description: Where a story was reported. Spillover links to sources; it never copies articles.
NewsSource.title: NewsSource

NewsStory.description: A recent real-world event, whether or not any claim is about it yet.
NewsStory.title: NewsStory

RespondsTo.description:
A claim written as an answer to another one, graded on its own like any claim.

* ``counter``: expects the opposite of the other claim (the other side of the argument).
* ``refine``: the same idea, narrowed or sharpened (another market, window or kind of event).
RespondsTo.title: RespondsTo

SiteIcons.description:
Real icons stored with the site (paths relative to the page): outlets, companies, people.

Built by spillover.ingest.icons; a name missing here has no icon, and the site never draws a
stand-in letter for it.
SiteIcons.title: SiteIcons

TaxonomyEntry.description: An event type a claim can name, where its events come from, and how many are in the data.
TaxonomyEntry.title: TaxonomyEntry

Window.description: Event window, in trading days, relative to the headline's first verifiable time.
Window.title: Window
